Bihar Vidhan Parishad Security Guard Final Result 2026

Post Date: August 9, 2026

9:27 am

Bihar Vidhan Parishad, has release the Final Result on its official website for the Reporter, Assistant, Assistant Caretaker, Data Entry Operator (DEO), Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Security Guard, Driver and Office Attendant Examination 2024. The Interview will be conducted on June 2026, The Bihar Vidhan Parishad application process started on 16 October 2024, and candidates were able to submit their applications until 25 October 2024. Candidates can check their Final Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below. (Advt.
